sentences.text:
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh Sl.No.
113 01.10.2024 Court No. 35 WPA 20221 of 2024 G.S.Das  Priyanka Sanfui  -Vs-  The State of West Bengal & Ors.

Mr. Pradyat Saha  Ms. Ratna Dey  ... for the petitioner  Mr. Vimal Kumar Shahi, ld. AGP  Mr. Sangeeta Roy  ... for the State-respondent Report submitted on behalf of the State be kept with the record.
Affidavit of service so submitted be also kept with the record.

The petitioner is aggrieved by the materials collected by the investigating agency in course of investigation and the conclusion of investigation by way of submission of Charge-sheet under Sections 498A/406/307/494/34 of the IPC.

As the Investigating Agency have completed the investigation and the case is before the learned jurisdictional court, I am of the view that the grievance be advanced by the petitioner as the defacto- complainant of the case, by way of invoking the provisions of either Section 173(8) of the cr.p.c. or Section 193(9) of the BNSS.
The petitioner would, if she is aggrieved, approach the learned jurisdictional court.
With the aforesaid observations, WPA 20221 of 2024 is disposed of.
Pending application, if any, is also disposed of.
